item.title: ‘X-Men’ & ‘Star Trek’ Star, Sir Patrick Stewart, Dead At 86
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: Sir Patrick Stewart, the iconic actor best known for his roles in Star Trek and X-Men films, has died at 86.
item.content:encoded:
Sir Patrick Stewart, the iconic actor best known for his roles in Star Trek and X-Men films, has died at 86.

Nerds, blerds, and anyone with a pulse are all deeply saddened after Stewart’s official social media accounts shared the sad news of the legendary actor’s passing.

“We announce with great sorrow the passing of Sir Patrick Stewart yesterday at his home in Los Angeles, in the loving care of his beloved wife Sunny, following a brief and poignant journey with Alzheimer’s Disease and Lewy Body Dementia,” the statement begins.

The statement adds that Stewart was “held in the warm embrace of friends and family” and “surrounded by live music, prayer, tears, laughter.”

Avengers: Doomsday & Possibly Secret Wars Could Be The Last Time We See Stewart on The Big Screen

It turns out the last time we will possibly see Stewart on the big screen will be as Professor X in the upcoming Marvel Studios film Avengers: Doomsday, and maybe in the follow-up, Secret Wars.

Marvel Studios has released a statement on Stewart’s passing:

“All of us at Marvel Studios are deeply saddened by the passing of Sir Patrick Stewart. Sir Patrick brought Professor Charles Xavier to life with extraordinary grace, intelligence, and humanity, defining the character for generations of fans, from X-Men to Logan to Avengers: Doomsday.

He was a singular talent, a generous collaborator, and a true gentleman. Our hearts go out to his wife Sunny, his children, his friends, and the countless fans around the world whose lives he touched with his art.“

Stewart will be missed, but he will live forever through his film and television contributions. See reactions to his passing below.

item.title: New ‘GTA 6’ Gameplay Featured On Latest Episode Of ‘South Park’
item.dc:creator: O Mazariego
item.description: We're just a few weeks away from GTA 6 finally hitting gaming systems and keeping most of the world indoors for the foreseeable future, and to further hype the upcoming release (as if it were necessary), some gameplay footage actually made its way onto the latest episode of South Park.
item.content:encoded:
We’re just a few weeks away from GTA 6 finally hitting gaming systems and keeping most of the world indoors for the foreseeable future, and to further hype the upcoming release (as if it were necessary), some gameplay footage actually made its way onto the latest episode of South Park.

While the gameplay wasn’t exactly action-driven or spoiler-heavy, it did show that players can hurl dog poop at other people during the game.

Throwing dog sh*t at people really is a lost art these days. Just sayin.’

Narrated by Tish Hicks, you can hear the voice of the original GTA 6 trailer break down the events unfolding, saying, “It’s a dog taking a poop, and people can pick up the dog poop. You can throw things at the person with dog poop, and if they choose to fight back, you can pick up the dog poop and actually attack them with the dog poop.”

You know heads are going to be using dog poop to start fights as many times as possible once this game hits the streets. Heck, people might begin hurling dog poop in the streets again in 2027, for all we know.

Check out the GTA 6 gameplay reveal on South Park below, and let us know in the comments if you’re excited to play; we already know you are from the reactions below.

item.title: A Florida Judge Grants 50 Cent A Temporary Restraining Order Against Rick Ross’ Baby Mama, Tia Kemp
item.dc:creator: O Mazariego
item.description: A Florida judge granted 50 Cent a temporary injunction protecting his 14-year-old son, Sire Jackson, from online harassment by Rick Ross' 49-year-old baby mama, Tia Kemp.
item.content:encoded:
Days ago, 50 Cent asked a court to order Rick Ross’ ex, Tia Kemp, to stop harassing his 14-year-old son on social media, and though Kemp has since posted multiple videos slandering 50 and his son, a court has sided with Diddy and granted him a protective order in the situation.

According to TMZ, a Florida judge granted 50 Cent a temporary injunction protecting his 14-year-old son, Sire Jackson, from online harassment by Rick Ross’ 49-year-old baby mama (Hip-Hop in 2026, y’all). In the court order, the Florida judge ordered Kemp to stay at least 500 feet away from the teenager and to refrain from contacting him, directly or indirectly, on social media.

If you’ve seen the videos she’s been posting lately, you know she’ll have something to say about this, since she’s already said she has nothing to lose.

Per TMZ:

The judge didn’t stop there … Tia is also prohibited from possessing firearms or ammunition. She must surrender any weapons in her possession to law enforcement when she is served with the order.

The temporary injunction comes after 50 filed papers on behalf of Sire, claiming Tia had repeatedly targeted his son online and allegedly called him “slow” and said he was on the autism spectrum.

Maybe Tia Kemp Went After The Wrong Kid

Maybe if Tia Kemp had gone after 50’s firstborn, Marquis Jackson, she wouldn’t have had a problem. 50 Cent apparently doesn’t like that kid that much.

It’s anyone’s guess how Tia Kemp will respond to this latest development, but don’t be surprised if she keeps clapping back at Fiddy for involving the law in this beef.

Check out one of Tia Kemp’s posts about her legal issues with 50 Cent below, and let us know your thoughts in the comments.

Social media has been reacting to this ongoing situation, and surprisingly, they have been coming for 50 Cent, mainly because he is a notorious bully and has made fun of other people’s kids. So it’s quite shocking to see him go this route when the tables are turned on him.

item.title: JAŸ-Z & J. Cole Submit Letters To A Federal Judge Supporting Lil Durk Getting Bail
item.dc:creator: O Mazariego
item.description: Jay-Z and J. Cole submitted support letters for Lil Durk's bail hearing, highlighting his community work and artistic growth despite his ongoing racketeering trial.
item.content:encoded:
Just last month, Lil Durk was found not guilty of putting out a hit on rival rapper Quando Rondo, but unfortunately the Chicago rapper remains behind bars as he awaits a second racketeering trial to get underway.

Lil Durk has since filed a motion to grant him bail, and while things aren’t exactly looking good at the moment for the “All My Life” rapper, Billboard is reporting that both Jay-Z and J. Cole have submitted letters of support for the motion to the federal judge overseeing the case in hopes of swaying the pendulum in Durk’s favor. While this may be a long shot, the judge may not even be a fan of rap; for all we know, it still shows that Lil Durk has some heavy hitters in his corner when he needs them.

Per Billboard:

In his letter, Jay-Z says he found Durk to be “kind, respectful and focused on his career” when they met several years earlier. “What stood out most to me was how he used his success,” writes Jay-Z. “Durk was signing young artists from his community to recording contracts and giving them a real path into a legitimate industry. Many of us come from neighborhoods where the options are limited, and the risks are high. Durk understood that, and he worked to help others find a way out of those conditions rather than leaving them behind.”

“Release would allow [Durk] to support his family and continue the work in his community that I saw firsthand,” adds Jay-Z.

J. Cole’s Message To Judge Vouched For Lil Durk’s Messaging In His Music

Cole, on the other hand, leaned into Durk’s message in his music, pointing to growth and maturity regardless of background or history.

“It speaks to the vision of Durk to mature and realize the impact his art could have, and then to be willing to fight for the chance to make that impact a positive one, even if it meant going against the instincts of an artist he respects and looks up to,” writes J. Cole.

Lil Durk was already denied bail once because the court labeled him a flight risk. Hoping to get their client out on bail before the start of trial, Durk’s defense lawyers, Brian Steel and Drew Findling, informed the court that Durk was willing to offer a bond package which promised that the rapper would forfeit any future earnings and would be willing to leave his family “penniless” should he violate his bond and go on the lam.

Whether any of these things will sway the judge to grant him bail remains to be seen, but we’ll find out November 4th when the hearing for Durk’s bond gets underway.

Do y’all think JAŸ and J. Cole will help or hurt Durk’s bond hearing? Does Durk offering his piggy bank hold more weight than the co-signs from his fellow rap peers? Let us know your thoughts and peep some reactions below.

item.title: Drake’s “Janice STFU” Copyright Lawsuit Thrown Out
item.dc:creator: Christopher Smith
item.description: According to reports, rapper/songwriter Aviel Hirschfield filed a motion in federal court on Tuesday (October 27) to dismiss his lawsuit against Drake. He offered no explanation for filing the motion in the letter requesting the dismissal.
item.content:encoded:
A copyright infringement lawsuit against Drake over his recent hit “Janice STFU” was dismissed less than two weeks after filing.

According to reports, rapper/songwriter Aviel Hirschfield filed a motion in federal court on Tuesday (October 27) to dismiss his lawsuit against Drake. He offered no explanation for filing the motion in the letter requesting the dismissal.

The Portland, Oregon-based Hirschfield filed his lawsuit against Drake on October 16, alleging that the Canadian star copied the entire chorus he wrote specifically for “Janice STFU”, which has gone on to be a major hit from Drake’s Iceman album. Hirschfield claims that he wrote the chorus in January, inspired by Swedish singer Lykke Li.

“This song was written specifically for Drake using music provided to [Hirschfield] that was created by Drake’s producers,” Hirschfield’s representative said at the time. The lawsuit claims that after he heard the track in May, Hirschfield sent “stems” to Drake’s producer FnZ as audio proof that he recorded the chorus first.

“The allegations are not merely disputed — we maintain that they are entirely fabricated, without credible factual support or legitimate legal foundation. Drake wrote this song and has no connection or knowledge of this person full stop,” attorneys for the “Headlines” rapper said in response to the lawsuit.

Aviel Hirschfield Has Worked With Beyoncé & Others

Prior to the lawsuit, Hirschfield’s most notable credit was as a co-writer on Beyoncé’s “Heated”, from her smash hit album Renaissance in 2022. But in a Rolling Stone report, he began bragging on social media that he was a “co-producer” on the song. In another twist, he actually shares writing credit with over a dozen other figures, including Drake.

Even with the swift request, the court dismissed Hirschfield’s lawsuit without prejudice. That distinction means that it can be brought again at a later date.

Peep reactions to the latest lawsuit being dismissed below.

item.title: Heckler Tells Donald Trump To Shove His Ballroom Up His Behind
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: Video of the yet-to-be-identified hero telling Trump, "shove that ballroom up your fat ass," quickly went viral on the internet.
item.content:encoded:
All heroes don’t wear capes. Case in point, a heckler at Donald Trump’s Mississippi rally told the liar-in-chief what a lot of people have been itching to tell him to his face.

Trump is still traveling the country and delivering his tired and very bizarre speeches, while putting on a masterclass in making the GOP toxic as hell; so much, in fact, that he has to visit a Republican stronghold like Mississippi because he has hurt the brand so much with his awful policies and unpopular war with Iran that Cindy Hyde-Smith is now in a tight Senate race to win reelection.

During his rally speeches, Trump is also experiencing more hecklers than usual, which is also a very telling sign that these midterm elections are not going particularly well for the MAGA movement.

This heckler, in particular, has already reached legendary status after sending a direct message about Agent Orange and his expensive vanity project, the White House Ballroom.

Video of the yet-to-be-identified hero telling Trump, “shove that ballroom up your fat ass,” quickly went viral on the internet.

The heckler even gave us a video from his point of view.

Trump, who isn’t one to be short on words, seemed to be a bit bothered by the heckler because he couldn’t come up with a response.

The Heckler Is Getting Plenty of Love On Social Media

Social media enjoyed the moment, praising the heckler as a hero for telling Trump he can take his ballroom and shove it.

“I’m having a bumper sticker made with: Trump, ‘Shove that ballroom up your fat ass,” one post read on social media.

Another post read, “Someone from the crowd yelled at Trump: ‘SHOVE THAT BALLROOM UP YOUR FAT ASS!!” Even in Mississippi, they’re fed up with him now.

We hope this energy continues, because Americans are fed up as they continue to suffer. Donald Trump continues to enrich himself and annoy us with his lame vanity projects, and, as our forever President Barack Obama said, has the White House “looking like Saddam Hussein opened a Cheesecake Factory.”

You can see more reactions below.

item.title: Tyga Sued For $135K Over Alleged Canceled Beijing Club Appearances
item.dc:creator: Weso
item.description: Tyga is reportedly facing a lawsuit over allegedly backing out of multiple club appearances in Beijing. Looks like T-Raww’s Beijing fans may not be hearing “Rack City” live anytime soon, as the West Coast rapper is dealing with some legal trouble. According to the lawsuit, Beijing Tongxing Wanxin Catering Management claims Tyga was booked to […]
item.content:encoded:
Tyga is reportedly facing a lawsuit over allegedly backing out of multiple club appearances in Beijing.

Looks like T-Raww’s Beijing fans may not be hearing “Rack City” live anytime soon, as the West Coast rapper is dealing with some legal trouble. According to the lawsuit, Beijing Tongxing Wanxin Catering Management claims Tyga was booked to appear at Club Pac in 2023 but allegedly failed to show up, not once, but twice.

The company claims the first appearance was scheduled for August 2023, followed by another date in October of that year. According to the allegations, Tyga was expected to reschedule the appearance for a third time in 2024, but no new date was ever confirmed.

Now, the company claims it received a $10,000 refund but is still seeking the remaining $135,000 from the original $145,000 booking fee. The lawsuit reportedly also still seeks punitive damages, bringing the dispute back into the spotlight years after the alleged missed appearances.

This isn’t the first time Tyga has faced legal trouble over unpaid bills. In 2023, the rapper was reportedly sued for $1.3 million over alleged missed payments on a Lamborghini and Bentley.

As of now, Tyaa and his team have not publicly addressed the latest allegations. Whether the dispute leads to a settlement or further legal action remains to be seen.

item.title: Cassie Dismissed From “Freak-Off” Lawsuit Against Diddy
item.dc:creator: Christopher Smith
item.description: A federal judge has granted Cassie’s request to be dropped from a lawsuit against Diddy, filed by a former escort who claimed that they were involved in “freak-off” sessions with her and Diddy.
item.content:encoded:
A federal judge has granted Cassie’s request to be dropped from a lawsuit against Diddy, filed by a former escort who claimed that they were involved in “freak-off” sessions with her and Diddy.

At a hearing in Los Angeles, California, last Wednesday (October 21), U.S. District Judge Anne Hwang granted Cassie’s motion to be removed from the lawsuit with prejudice. That distinction means Cassie cannot be sued on the same grounds in another lawsuit.

“Defendant Ventura’s motion to dismiss is hereby granted; this will be the order as stated on the record,” the filing read. Clayton Howard’s lawsuit will proceed, with Diddy, aka Sean Combs, as the sole defendant.

Howard, who had previously worked as a male escort using the name “Dave”, first filed the lawsuit seeking $35 million in damages against Cassie, aka Cassandra Ventura, Combs, Bad Boy Entertainment LLC, and CeOpco LLC last year. 

He alleged that Cassie arranged the sex sessions under Diddy’s direction, and that he was abused through coercion and the use of drugs in those paid encounters which took place in New York City, Miami, and Los Angeles.

Cassie’s lawyers argued that Howard being paid and agreeing to return visits proved his allegations in the lawsuit weren’t valid. “These defects are not curable by better drafting or any reframing of the facts,” they wrote.

Howard later had to amend his lawsuit after that motion, even trying to submit a rewritten account of his earlier claim that Diddy detained him for 12 hours during one session in Miami in December 2016. That was
denied before the October 21 hearing.

Further filings from Cassie’s lawyers also say she is now an American citizen living abroad, with no intention of returning. Cassie and her husband, Alex Fine, quietly relocated ahead of Diddy’s racketeering and sex trafficking trial, which resulted in him receiving a 50-month prison sentence last October.

item.title: 50 Cent Asks A Court To Keep Rick Ross’ Ex, Tia Kemp From Harassing His Son
item.dc:creator: O Mazariego
item.description: 50 Cent sues Tia Kemp for cyberstalking his 14-year-old son Sire, claiming she's bullied him online and called him 'slow' and autistic.
item.content:encoded:
Back in 2009, when 50 Cent was publicly feuding with Rick Ross, he released a diss record dubbed “Tia Told Me” in which he bragged about spending time with Ross’ baby mother, Tia Kemp, and “exposed” Ricky’s dirty laundry.

Fast forward 16 years, and it seems 50’s apparent friendship with Rick Ross’ baby mama has gotten a bit hostile as he takes her to court to leave his family alone.

According to TMZ Hip Hop, 50 Cent has filed a lawsuit against Tia Kemp, asking a court to order her to stop cyberstalking his 14-year-old son, Sire Jackson, claiming that Kemp has been bullying him online, calling him “slow” and saying the kid is on the “autism spectrum.”

Tia Kemp is 49 years old, by the way. We just thought we’d point that out given the situation.

50 Cent Opts For The Legal Route Instead of Trolling

While a G-Unit version of 50 Cent might’ve handled it more personally, this older, wiser Curtis Jackson is taking a more mature route and asking the law to act on his behalf. Feeling this online harassment will cause his teenage son humiliation and mental stress, 50 hopes the court will be able to get Kemp to stop the bullying before things go too far.

Per TMZ:

50 also takes issue with Tia allegedly posting a photo of Sire alongside a sexually explicit image of a woman the rapper’s filing suggests is his mother, Daphne Joy.

According to the filing, Tia allegedly targeted Sire in four separate online publications over just six days, including an October 25 interview in which she again called the teen “slow” and claimed he “can’t talk.”

50 claims his attorneys previously sent Tia a cease-and-desist letter demanding she remove the offending posts and stop publishing the material … but she allegedly fired back by posting part of the letter with the caption, “F u and ya lawyers.”

We have to wonder where things went wrong between 50 and Tia, since they seemed to be on the same page in 2009.

50 is asking for a temporary injunction to keep Tia Kemp from cyberstalking and harassing the 14-year-old before a final injunction can be made.

What do y’all think about Tia Kemp’s online actions against 50 Cent’s son? Why doesn’t she just harass 50 himself and leave the kid alone?

item.title: Nicki Minaj For White House Press Secretary? Is This A Joke?
item.dc:creator: Stephen A. Crockett Jr.
item.description: White House Communications Director Steven Cheung interviewed rapper Nicki Minaj on Air Force One about a potential press secretary role, leaving people unsure if it was serious or satirical.
item.content:encoded:
The Trump administration is such a mess that when a White House official floats the idea of rapper Nicki Minaj becoming the next White House Press Secretary, America doesn’t know if they’re joking or not.

White House Communications Director Steven Cheung apparently decided the best way to spend a flight aboard Air Force One was to conduct a mock job interview with Minaj, asking the rapper about President Donald Trump before suggesting she could replace the administration’s press secretary.

Cheung shared a two-minute video Sunday showing himself interviewing Minaj as they traveled to Michigan, where she was scheduled to join Trump at a campaign rally ahead of the Nov. 3 midterm elections.

And not everyone was sure he was joking.

Minaj quote-posted the video with an American flag and a grinning face with sweat emoji. The White House responded with , while Trump adviser Alex Bruesewitz asked the Barbz what they thought about their favorite rapper taking a job that requires answering questions about the president’s daily shenanigans.

No appointment was announced, but apparently the White House has decided running the country and auditioning celebrities can happen at the same time.

During the staged interview, Minaj praised Trump’s business experience, arguing that his personal financial struggles prepared him to manage the nation’s finances. She also complimented his international negotiations and work ethic.

“He outworks people that are half his age,” Minaj said, according to Mediaite.

Because nothing says economic expertise like a man whose business career includes multiple bankruptcies. Minaj also encouraged Trump supporters not to get discouraged by polling figures Cheung characterized as unreliable, invoking Hillary Clinton’s election experience.

In other words, it was less a job interview and more a campaign commercial featuring a celebrity guest.

The timing is particularly ridiculous because the press secretary position recently became vacant. Trump appointed Katie Zacharia on Oct. 9, and she began work three days later, succeeding Karoline Leavitt, who left in August.

Zacharia’s tenure lasted just five days. Her only White House press briefing lasted about 14 minutes and drew questions from three reporters, according to the Associated Press.

The Pepperdine University law school graduate also faced scrutiny after admitting she hadn’t passed the California bar exam, despite previously describing herself as a lawyer.

On Oct. 16, Reuters reported, citing two U.S. officials, that she had been fired.

Now Minaj is apparently in the mix. At this point, the White House press secretary job needs a casting director, not a résumé, and a “beautiful ass.”

Peep what social media had to say about this nonsense below.

item.title: Latest ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Teaser Has Fans Speculating Captain America Isn’t Captain America
item.dc:creator: O Mazariego
item.description: We're still two months away from the highly anticipated world premiere of Avengers: Doomsday, and while rumors and theories are still running rampant about what will happen in the film, one theory seems to have gained traction in the latest Doomsday TV spot.
item.content:encoded:
We’re still two months away from the highly anticipated world premiere of Avengers: Doomsday, and while rumors and theories are still running rampant about what will happen in the film, one theory seems to have gained traction in the latest Doomsday TV spot.

Over the weekend, Marvel Studios dropped a quick 30-second commercial featuring Ant-Man (Paul Rudd) calling Steve Rogers (Chris Evans) Cap, even though Sam Wilson (Anthony Mackie) is currently Captain America in the MCU. Still, Rogers turns to look at Ant-Man as if he’s still Captain America. That led many online heads to once again suggest that Steve Rogers isn’t actually Steve, but rather Loki pretending to be Steve Rogers.

Sounds complicated, we know, but if you’ve been keeping up with the MCU for the last decade and change you’d understand. Also, Loki does indeed possess the ability to turn into whoever he wants to, and as for him being able to hold Thor’s hammer, Mjölner, in other trailers for the film, his redemption arc in the Loki series can easily explain why he’s worthy of holding Thor’s hammer now (pause?).

That said, another theory suggests Steve Rogers is actually the evil Captain Hydra from another timeline, secretly working with Dr. Doom to take down the Avengers from the inside before the real Captain America returns to save the day in the upcoming 2027 sequel, Avengers: Secret Wars.

Whatever the case may be, we have heard that test screenings for Avengers: Doomsday scored higher than those for Avengers: Endgame, and we all know how amazing Endgame was when it released in 2019. That says something, and we can’t wait to see if it’s true when Doomsday hits theaters on December 18th.

Check out the latest teaser spot for Avengers: Doomsday below, and let us know in the comments whether you think this is actually Captain America or Loki pretending to be Cap.

item.dc:creator: Weso

Brown’s vocal coach, Omololu Akinlolu, […]
item.content:encoded:
Chris Brown’s ongoing legal situation in London has taken another turn, with his prison sentence reportedly suspended.

The R&B singer ran into legal trouble following an alleged incident at a London nightclub in 2023. Brown was accused of using a glass weapon and striking a man in the head twice.

Brown’s vocal coach, Omololu Akinlolu, was also reportedly accused of being invovled in the alleged assault.

After pleading guilty, Breezy was handed an eight-month prison sentence. However, according to reports, the sentence has been suspended for 12 months, meaning he will not have to serve time behind bards as long as he meets the conditions of his suspended sentence.

Chris has also faced issues with one of his child’s mothers, Diamond Brown. She has allegedly claimed that the singer doesn’t spend enough time with their daughter.

One of Brown’s other partners responded to Diamond’s comments, pushing back against her claims and accusing her of being ungrateful. 

“Diamond please…everyone of us is OVERLY taken care of and you know that. Stop being ungrateful and miserable.”

Meanwhile, the Virginia-born singer has been on the road, touring alongside Usher. Despite his ongoing legal matters, Brown continues to maintain his presence in the music world.

With the 12-month suspension period now in play, Brown will need to comply with the court’s conditions to avoid serving his prison sentence.

item.title: Cardi B Addresses Nicki Minaj Fans Upset She Didn’t Credit Her For Being An Influence
item.dc:creator: O Mazariego
item.description: Cardi B took to X Spaces to interact with fans and address critics over the list of personal influencers she gave The New York Times.
item.content:encoded:
Just because it’s been a minute since Cardi B and Nicki Minaj traded barbs doesn’t mean they’ve made amends; recently, Cardi B reminded the world that, despite the silence, no love is lost between the two biggest female rappers in the game.

On Wednesday (Oct. 21), Cardi B took to X Spaces to interact with fans and address critics over the list of personal influencers she gave The New York Times. While she credited Madonna, Lil Kim, and Foxy Brown with helping shape her style and persona, many fans pointed out that she left out Nicki Minaj, who was huge when Cardi B was starting her rap career.

While some felt this was the right moment for Cardi B to extend an olive branch and credit Nicki Minaj with influencing her rap aspirations, Cardi stood by Bronx business and completely omitted the Queens rapper from her list. Even admitting she knew Foxy didn’t like her personally, Cardi said she added her to the list because she used to listen to her when she was younger.

Nicki, on the other hand, Mrs. B didn’t feel the need to include her on her list, saying, “I am a New York hood b*tch,” before going on to say, “If you’re imitating other b*tches, you’re not gonna make it. If you imitate other b*tches’ mannerisms, you’re not gonna make it because you’re not being yourself. So me making it, it was because I’m being myself. There’s nobody I ever wanna be. I became famous being Cardi B.”

Well, she’s not wrong. Though unfortunately for her, no matter what she does or says going forward, Nicki Minaj fans will always somehow connect her career moves to their favorite Barbz. That’s just how the game goes these days. Luckily for Cardi, though, MAGA country could care less about Nicki Minaj no matter how much she endears herself to Trump world. If they did, that would’ve been a whole other world of online harassment. Just sayin.’

Check out Cardi B address the Nicki Minaj “outrage” below and let us know your thoughts in the comments section.

item.title: Donald Trump Fawns Over Nicki Minaj’s Enhanced Cakes In Bizarre Rally Moment
item.dc:creator: Tron Snow
item.description: Trump made inappropriate comments about Nicki Minaj's body at a Michigan rally, praising her appearance while she stood beside him. Social media criticized both figures.
item.content:encoded:
Donald Trump continues to talk about admiring butts during his campaign rallies; this time, Nicki Minaj got some love from Orange Mussolini.

At a recent rally on Sunday in Michigan for Republican Senate candidate Mike Rodgers, Trump made cheeky comments about Minaj’s surgically enhanced cheeks while praising Republican Ohio senator Jon Husted’s rear end.

For those who have been under a rock, Trump has repeatedly expressed admiration for Husted’s behind. Early in October, he said of the former football player: “I don’t do this with men very often. I started examining his body, because I didn’t know he was a great athlete. And I looked, and I watched up and down. I looked at his ass, and I looked at the whole – and then I looked at his hands. Look at his hands. He’s got these, like, claws.

“You are a great athlete,” Trump also said to Husted. “Congratulations.”

Keep in mind he was supposed to be rallying for Rogers, who is currently in a tight race with Democrat Abdul-Sayed, so this whole situation is already baffling, and we have no idea how Trump’s constant admiration for the male physique will help Rogers.

Anyway, Trump then claimed that the media, understandably perplexed by his comments, was nothing but “fake news” and that they were disregarding the athletic context of his weird comments. According to Orange Mussolini, he only learned Husted was a college athlete when he was “looking at him up and down, and I’m studying him.”

According to Trump, his comments are “in fun.” “I said: I looked at his ass, and I’ve never done that with a man before. It’s true. Off the record, women yes, men no, OK.”

Bruh.

Trump then turned his attention to Nicki Minaj, who was at the rally and flew with him on Qatar Force One.

“By the way, I looked at one hell of a beautiful ass before – Nicki Minaj,” Trump said, which got a huge pop from the crowd. “That’s hard to miss. That – stand up! That’s hard to miss.”

Minaj’s ass is indeed hard to miss because she has admittedly had it plumped up thanks to butt injections from who she claimed was a “random person.”

“OK, I’m going to get back to my story, Nicki,” Trump continued. “I hope Nicki wasn’t insulted, but we love Nicki. She’s been with us for a long time.”

After standing up and acknowledging Trump, Minaj took the stage and joined Trump, where she expressed her love for the racist-in-chief, claiming that if he ran for an unconstitutional third term, she would support him again, even though, due to her not being a citizen, she can’t vote.

This bizarre turn of events followed Barack Obama hilariously clowning Trump at his rally for Abdul-Sayed, making light of his tacky White House renovations.

As expected, social media has been clowning Nicki Minaj, reminding her she’s married to a registered sex offender, and her brother is a pedophile after she said she wanted people to leave children alone, ridiculously claiming they are being “bombarded with sex changes.”

You can see more reactions below.

item.title: “What’s with all the gold?”: Barack Obama Clowns Donald Trump’s White House Renovations
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: Former President Barack Obama was in rare form during two rallies in Michigan and Ohio, clowning Donald Trump and his tacky renovations.
item.content:encoded:
Former President Barack Obama was in rare form during two rallies in Michigan and Ohio, clowning Donald Trump and his tacky White House renovations.

At a rally in Detroit, Michigan, Obama put on his closer hat and stumped for Democrat Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed and other Michigan Democrats, and he didn’t disappoint.

Obama took the gloves off and slammed Trump, pointing out that the current occupant of the White House couldn’t care less about the American people and only cares about enriching himself and his vanity projects.

The former president focused on Trump’s affinity for gold, while calling out his other “renovations” to the White House, painting a picture of a president more concerned with home improvement than with the needs of the American people.

“He seems very focused on home renovations. He should be on HGTV,” Obama joked while touching on Trump’s $900 million worth of White House “improvements.” “What’s with the gold? … He’s got the White House looking like Saddam Hussein opened a Cheesecake Factory.”

Barack Obama Slammed Pete Hegseth

Our former president also had time for Trump’s cabinet too, specifically his DEI hire, Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth.

“You got the defense secretary who is like a laser focused on important matters like the jawline and testosterone levels of our troops, and livestreaming executions because that’s how he thinks you cultivate that manly warrior spirit. How much time do you think this man spends in front of the mirror every day?” Obama said of Hegseth’s weird obsessions.

Trump, who was also out rallying for Republican candidates, caught wind of Obama’s zingers at him and let off a long, nonsensical tirade on his crappy platform, Truth Social, using the same tired and racist attacks to call out his rival and Abdul-Sayed.

Anyway, the internet absolutely loved seeing and hearing Barack Obama clowing Trump.

Gotta love Obama.

item.title: Still the Jesus Guy: Kirk Franklin Talks I Am What I Am and Faith Without Filters
item.dc:creator: Nia Noelle
item.description: Kirk Franklin discusses his double album 'I Am What I Am,' emphasizing authenticity in faith, the distinction between forgiveness and trust, and remaining true to his gospel identity across all collaborations.
item.content:encoded:
Kirk Franklin walked into the “Posted on the Corner” studio with three decades of gospel history behind him and a new project to share. In a lively conversation with hosts Incognito and DJ Misses, the gospel icon moved easily between punchlines and preaching. It was a clear reminder of why he remains one of the most influential voices in Black music.

A Double Album, Two Sides of Worship

Franklin came to talk about I Am What I Am, his first-ever double album. The project is split into two experiences. One side holds seven tracks recorded live in church, carrying the Sunday-morning energy longtime fans know well. The other side offers seven studio tracks with guest features, including GloRilla on “Glow” and Tobe Nwigwe.

Still “The Jesus Guy”

Working with secular artists has never meant compromise, Franklin said. He called himself “the Jesus guy,” past, present, and future, and said he does not change who he is to fit anyone’s sound. He looked back on his youth, when he rapped as “Kid Fresh” and lived a wild life outside the church. Even then, gospel was the only music he ever wanted to make.

DJ Misses asked what he had finally stopped apologizing for. His answer centered on embracing imperfection and serving a God who meets people as they are. “Let me love you where you are to where I’m taking you,” he said.

Hard Truths on Forgiveness

The mood turned serious when Franklin spoke about forgiveness. “Forgiveness is free, but trust is earned,” he said. Forgiveness is a commandment, he explained, but forgetting runs on its own timeline. The person who caused the hurt cannot rush that process, especially if they are not doing the work.

He summed up his outlook plainly: “Jesus didn’t die for religion. He died so we got relationship with him.”

TRENDING STORY: Power Plays, Deepfake Drama & Dirty Corporate Secrets! Inside BOSSIP’s Addictive New TikTok Thriller ‘Power & Influence’ [Exclusive]

TRENDING STORY: The Lasting Impact of Kirk Franklin on Gospel Music

The laughs came often. Franklin and the hosts traded stories about old-school church rules with no biblical basis, like no baseball caps in the pulpit and shutting off the TV and lights whenever it thundered. Anyone raised in the Black church likely recognized every one. Franklin also joked that he and gospel legend Shirley Caesar used to date, then told the crew to “clip that.” He admitted his younger self should have let the S-curl go much sooner.

When Incognito asked which secular artist he would love to executive produce, Franklin named Jazmine Sullivan and Beyoncé.

Flowers While He Can Smell Them

Near the end, Incognito and DJ Misses gave Franklin his flowers. They thanked him for his transparency, for music that has saved lives, and for openly sharing his platform and his family’s struggles.

It was a fitting close to a conversation built on honesty. With I Am What I Am, Franklin is offering his community the same thing he offered on the Corner: faith, laughter, and the freedom to show up exactly as you are.

item.title: “Every AI Has Its Cost”: Jay Jones and Donnie Carrington Talk Power, Ambition, and Micro-Drama Mess
item.dc:creator: Nia Noelle
item.description: Jay Jones and Donnie Carrington star in TikTok's new thriller 'Power & Influence,' a fast-paced drama about ambition and betrayal at a Black-owned PR firm.
item.content:encoded:
DJ Misses sits down with two stars of the new TikTok micro-series Power and Influence. Jay Jones plays Chris Whitmore, and Donnie Carrington plays Dominic Wells. The is out now on Bossip of TikTok, and both actors arrived ready to talk.

Big Moments, Small Window

With episodes averaging about 90 seconds, there’s no time to warm up. Carrington described his approach plainly: “You got to be raw, you got to be real, you got to be unapologetic. You got to know your instrument.”

Jones agreed and said the key is connecting with the character right away. “Characters call to you,” he said. “When you can make that connection to the character, it becomes very organic. So you don’t really need a whole lot of runway to take off.”

Jones described the show’s setting as an all-Black public relations firm with “energy similar to Boomerang.” Chris and his wife founded the company. They bring in AI agents to stay competitive, and that’s when the ambition and backstabbing start. Chris is “very manipulative,” Jones admitted, but “at the heart of it all, he’s a family man.”

Dominic is Chris’s protégé, and he’s hungry. “He’s an opportunist,” Carrington explained. “If this move is going to get me further, I probably need to navigate that. It’s a game. It’s chess.” He also had a warning for viewers: “When I pop on the screen, you’re probably gonna have to rewind it.”

A Modern Moral Tale

Jones compared the series to “a Shakespearean play.” “The whole point of art is to challenge the viewer,” he said. “It’s not just entertainment. It’s about healing, exploration, human development.” Carrington added that the story carries a real lesson about mentors, mentees, and trust: “You can’t trust everybody.”

The AI Conversation

Since the show deals with AI, DJ Misses asked the actors where they stand. Carrington called it a useful tool for workflow. He drew the line at using people’s likenesses, especially artists who have passed: “They still have a family.”

Jones compared AI to early electricity. It can “burn your house completely down” or “illuminate every corner of your dark house.” He added, “It’s all how you use it.”

TRENDING STORY: Yung Miami Gets Real About Music, Mom Life & Legacy

Things weren’t always serious on set. A castmate from Baltimore had everyone cracking up with her accent, and Jones says viewers will know exactly who he means. As for theme music, Jones chose James Brown for Chris: “I paid the cost to be the boss.”

item.title: Exclusive: Jeff Negus Talks Exploring Provocative Subject Matter In ‘Modern Warfare 4’s Campaign
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: Modern Warfare 4's campaign tackles controversial topics like North Korea, featuring intense moments players can't skip. Director Jeff Negus explains the team's thoughtful approach to provocation.
item.content:encoded:
In Call of Duty: Modern Warfare campaigns, you can always expect them to touch on topics that will elicit strong reactions. Infinity Ward’s narrative director, Jeff Negus, broke down that process for us ahead of the game’s release.

Don’t expect Modern Warfare 4’s campaign to shy away from any sensitive material. The game has already sparked plenty of conversation thanks to one moment that forces players to make a very hard choice, but unlike Modern Warfare 2’s very controversial mission “No Russian,” you can’t skip it.

Being Provocative Is Part of Modern Warfare’s DNA

In Modern Warfare 4’s campaign, we see tensions in the Korean peninsula hit a tipping point with North Korea doing the unthinkable by attacking its neighbor, South Korea. While the game doesn’t portray North Korea’s real-life dictator, including the country is still a huge risk; just ask Sony, Seth Rogen, and James Franco how that worked out for them and their film, The Interview.

We asked Negus about how he and his team approached including North Korea in Modern Warfare 4’s campaign without worrying if there would be any pushback from the country.

“Yeah. Look, we approach all that with a lot of care and thought. We make an entertainment product that is ripped from the headlines, and part of the DNA of Modern Warfare is to be provocative,” Negus begins. “So it’s really important to us that we are finding our own line, not to quote the theme of the game, but it’s important that we push it to the right place for the right reasons.”

“For me, I’m fortunate because I get to stick to the narrative. I get to stick to characters. This is so much more about drawing authentic people in a situation you can understand and empathize with. At the end of the day, even those provocative situations that players will definitely find themselves in, and this game is no exception, it’s to put yourself in the shoes of a character in the middle of a story, and the effect of having that experience aligns you with the characters more deeply. It’s what immerses you in the story.”

He continues, “To me, that’s what makes this medium powerful. I don’t think it’s worth it to shy away from those experiences. I think the onus is on us to be tasteful, thoughtful, and try to bring to bear the moments that are really going to immerse you and make you care about what happens to these characters.”

Joseph Lee Reveals What Made Him Enlist In Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4

Modern Warfare 4 isn’t short on star power in bringing characters to life. Barry Sloane returns as John Price, Mads Mikkelsen brings his signature villainous flair as The Archer, and 38-year-old actor Joseph Lee (Beef) plays Captain Kwon Hae-Soo, aka Kal, in the video game, leading a group of young South Korean and American marines trying to stave off a North Korean invasion.

We asked Lee, a Korean American, whether Modern Warfare 4’s campaign lured him into joining the cast. He said it was Call of Duty’s popularity that led him to enlist and be part of the latest chapter in Modern Warfare lore.

“To be honest, I wasn’t familiar with the game, but when it was presented to me, I mean, obviously I know of the game; it’s a household name,” Lee begins. “So I think just the curiosity about how big this franchise is really tickled me. So as an actor, you always want to try something new. This was my first experience delving into the gaming world. Through it, I’ve had an extraordinary education and just a wonderful experience working with people.”

Modern Warfare 4 is also his first video game-related gig. When we brought up that he was being fan-cast for a future Ghost of Tsushima movie, he revealed he had no idea that was a thing.

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is out now. Keep it locked on HHW Gaming for our campaign review.

item.content:encoded:
Boosie Badazz’s son, Ivy Ray Hatch, has reportedly been arrested on multiple charges.

The 18-year-old was booked on allegations including drug possession and armed robbery, according to reports. The Livingston Parish Sheriff’s Office reportedly confirmed that Hatch was taken into custody on Thursday.

Hatch has since been released on bond. The charges reportedly include possession of drug paraphernalia, possession of a firearm while in possession of drugs, and aggravated battery.

Boosie has yet to publicly comment on his son’s arrest. Meanwhile, the Louisiana rapper has been keeping busy as a special guest on the Cash Money and No Limit Tour in his home state.

Unfortunately, this isn’t the first time one of Boosie’s sons has faced legal trouble. His other son, Tootie Raww, was arrested in Atlanta last year on an obstruction charge.

Following Tootie’s arrest, Boosie opened up about his concerns for his son’s safety. Explaining how the people around him and the possibility of him making the wrong decisions have him worried.

“I gotta stop him from crashing out. Then it worry me more all them lil n***as around him clutching. It’s easy for something to happen… Got me worried as a daddy.”

For now, Boosie has not publicly addressed his son’s latest arrest.
